subject: mozilla-ai/any-guardrail request-time guardrail runtime integration
canonical_classification: Optional request-time multi-guardrail provider and architectural pattern source under the existing P0 AI security validation profile.
mandatory_constraint: any-guardrail SHALL NOT become a security-policy, authorization, MCP/tool, model-routing, host-resource, evidence, secrets, network-egress, artifact-trust, promotion, orchestration or registry authority.
reconciliation_basis: The existing AI security profile already owns security assurance and the Host Resource Broker already owns resource/QoS placement. This decision adds only request-time guardrail contracts, a bounded optional provider, and missing runtime/QoS regression semantics while preserving later main-branch PyRIT and page-cache/prefetch materializations.
